bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
dry="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs 2>&1)" || exit 61
printf '%s' "$dry" | grep -q '"mode":"DRY_RUN"' || exit 62
test "$(printf '%s' "$dry" | grep -o '"pinState":"published"' | wc -l)" -eq 2 || exit 63
docker exec -e VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_ENTRY_APPLY=enabled deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs >/dev/null || exit 64
check="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs 2>&1)" || exit 65
test "$(printf '%s' "$check" | grep -o '"pinState":"published"' | wc -l)" -eq 2 || exit 66
echo "TWO_EXISTING_MENUS_REFRESHED_DB_PINNED=PASS"
